description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Fetch and read the web] Link preview / URL unfurl API. Everything needed to render a link card from one public page: title, description, site name, Open Graph image (size, alt), canonical URL, best favicon plus all icons, logo (JSON-LD Organization), web manifest, theme colour, Twitter card fields, author and dates. Cached 1 h. ~0.3-2 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: Page to preview: a public http(s) URL, e.g. https://example.com/

name: link_preview

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Link preview / unfurl (title, description, image, favicon, logo) ($0.002/call)
